fields.statement: At 1213886b I ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api/ -run TestShip, and every ship test passed with the fake gh. TestShipOpenPRRefusesForeignPR covers a PR body that names another change set and a body with no 'Change set' line, each OPEN, MERGED and CLOSED, with the foreign commit both ahead on origin and absent from it. In every case it gets exit 3 with a conflict naming #7, no pr create or pr edit, no ship state, HEAD unmoved (nothing pulled in) and origin's branch unmoved (nothing pushed). TestShipCheckRefusesForeignPR covers ship check with {} and with settled:true on the same bodies plus an empty body, in all three states: each is refused with a conflict naming #345 and the state file is not written. TestShipOpenPR and TestShipCheckGreenThenMerge pass, so a PR that names the run's change set is still tracked. Reading the diff, open-pr now looks the PR up and calls requirePROwned before shipFollowPR and shipPush, and ship check calls requirePROwned before it writes state. As a mutation check, I restored the old ship_openpr.go in a scratch worktree, and the new test failed on HEAD moving and on origin's branch moving.
